lesson.uz:
While shartni avval tekshiradi: shart False bo‘lsa, tana bir marta ham bajarilmaydi. Takrorlash soni oldindan noma’lum bo‘lganda ishlating.
To‘xtash belgisi 0 bo‘lsa, birinchi qiymatni sikldan oldin o‘qing. Siklda uni qayta ishlang, keyin keyingi Input’ni bajaring. 0 ni hisobga qo‘shmang. Shartga ta’sir qiluvchi qiymat yangilanmasa, cheksiz sikl paydo bo‘ladi.
lesson.en:
While checks its condition first, so its body may run zero times. Use it when the number of repetitions is unknown.
For a sentinel of 0, read once before the loop, process the value, then read again inside the loop. Do not count the sentinel. If the condition never changes, the loop will not finish.
